protocol.wire: one JSON object per line; client sends {type:'user',message:{role,content:[...]}}; engine emits system/init, assistant, task_*, result
protocol.surface: assistant text/tool_use blocks, task_started/progress/updated events, terminal result with is_error/usage
protocol.notes: Official headless mode (docs: codebuddy.ai/docs/cli/headless). -y is REQUIRED for non-interactive runs and --permission-prompt-tool is NOT supported: approvals cannot be forwarded, the engine auto-approves. Images ride as base64 content blocks.
